label: IGF Code and flashpoint: an IGF ship under SOLAS chapter II-1 part G, a gas carrier under the IGC Code, and one temperature scale with LNG and methanol far below the 60 °C line and normal oil fuel at 60 °C or more.

steps.title: 1 · Mandatory under SOLAS chapter II-1, part G, for new ships using these fuels
2 · Low-flashpoint fuel: LNG and methanol flash far below the line
3 · Normal oil fuel: flashpoint not less than 60 °C
4 · Gas carriers burning their cargo follow the IGC Code instead
